meta.label: ASHLAR · Màn chọn nghề (sáu bàn tay)

generator.name: hand-authored (env/choiceHands.js)
generator.note: hash01(i, seed) drives the dust motes; wallBlend / wallTone use seeds 11, 12, 21, 22; the ledge stone texture seeds 11..15

code.note: sha256 of the listed lab source files at export time; labCommit = lookdev-lab HEAD; uncommitted = listed files that differ from HEAD (the export used the working tree)

coordinateSystem.system: three.js right-handed, Y up. x = right, y = up, z = toward the viewer. The wall is the plane z = 0 (skull tops z = 0, recesses -0.05); the ledge top is y = 0, the candle stands on it.
coordinateSystem.yaw: yawDeg = rotation about +Y in degrees, three.js Object3D.rotation.y (positive turns +z toward +x: a piece whose front is local +z faces (sin yaw, cos yaw): 0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west).
coordinateSystem.handFrame: arm frame of a hand model: origin at the sleeve end, +z along the forearm toward the fingertips, +y the back of the hand, x across

bounds.note: a stage, not a map: the wall (width x height) and the ledge in front of it

fl.name: hand FL
fl.reason: class-select hand model (prepared by scripts/prepare-choice-hands.py from the Tripo hand, with a sleeve extension; FL also rigged): Art_Final/Resource_3D_Optimized holds map props only, so there is no GLB for it in Art_Final
fl.note: Flagellant hand (Tripo) with a Blender rig of 22 bones (hand_root, forearm, wrist, thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky _01.._03; sockets fx_palm / fx_thumb / fx_tip_index)

atRest.note: model world matrix = root(position, quaternion, scale) * slide(z) * wrist(z) * arm(z, scale.x = mirror ? -1 : 1); modelWorldMatrix is the product (column-major, ready for Matrix4.fromArray) and is the placement of the hand model (asset frame = the prepared frame, no extra matrix)

offered.note: when this hand is chosen: root quaternion slerps qIdle -> qReach, the arm slides slideM metres along its own +z (slide.z = -back + slide), the wrist pitches wristPitchDeg; then the camera orbits per showcase

wall.composition: for a wall point (x, y) (world, y up): uv = (x / tileSizeM + offsets[tile][0], y / tileSizeM + offsets[tile][1]) per tile (periodic tiles, v up, image row 0 = top); result = mix(tileA, tileB, blend(x, y)); normals blended as vectors

blendMask.note: 8-bit grey over the wall, PNG row 0 = TOP of the wall, value / 255 = share of tile B (env/choiceHands.js wallBlend)

toneMask.mapping: vertex colour brightness = 0.76 + 0.32 * value / 255 (wallTone), one value per plane vertex, row 0 = top

ledge.material: procedural stone (256 px value-noise map + normal, scenes/choiceHands.js stoneTextures), roughness 0.93, normalScale 0.9

parts.name: Wax
parts.material: MeshBasicMaterial with painted vertex colours (golden cream gradient, scenes/choiceHands.js paintWax)

glowSprite.note: wall glow, colour x settings.glow (0.15) x flicker

soot.note: soft vertical black smudge above the flame

dustMotes.note: additive warm sprites drifting round the candle

idle.note: long lens straight on the wall; fovForAspect(aspect): wider viewports keep fov 16, narrower ones grow it so the whole key-art frame stays visible: fov = 2 atan(tan(8 deg) * keyartAspect / aspect)

camera.offerNote: on choosing a hand the camera dollies to a fitted pose (fitOfferCamera: offerFit) and then orbits per showcase[id].cam

keyArt.note: KEYART is the measured key-art geometry (normalised x, y of sleeve / wrist / tip per hand, origin top-left) that the slot table is calibrated to; the image is only a calibration overlay

lights.name: Gennet's candle (shadowed spot)
lights.note: intensity = baseIntensity * settings.candle * candleLevel(t, 3.1) * boost; the position leans toward the hovered / chosen hand (settings.lean)

lighting.defaultNote: no moods: the scene keeps its own lighting under every Act I mood; all lights are driven per frame (candle flicker candleLevel(t, seed), lean toward the hovered / chosen hand, class light from showcase)

environment.note: a trace of cold night env so the steel stand-in and the ring metals reflect something; the candle does the work

PB.note: Găng sắt, đinh quan tài bạc trên khớp, vết dây hằn trong lòng tay

FL.note: Dây thắt nút quấn hai vòng cổ tay, cổ tay áo đen của nữ tu

OS.note: Bàn tay già: mực và vữa trong nếp tay, nhẫn đốt xương

BR.note: Muối nứt trắng ngả xanh, tay áo ố vệt triều, vòng vỏ sò

EX.note: Găng tẩm dầu đèn, chai ngón cái

PS.note: Sẹo bỏng, tro dưới móng, bím chỉ đỏ

interaction.trail: The stranger's hand crumbles on the ossuary floor when the Keystone lets go of the Wall

fingerRig.note: finger rig drive data (only the rigged Flagellant hand has bones): relaxed -> open (offered) -> grip, degrees per segment
